lines.en: Grass grows in my mane

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩过草地很轻
lines.en: My hooves are light across the grass

lines.zh: 绿草从我的背缝里钻出来
lines.en: Green blades push out of the seams of my back

lines.zh: 我走起来带着草的沙沙声
lines.en: I move with a rustle of grass

lines.zh: 我低头就让草擦过鼻子
lines.en: I lower my head and grass brushes my nose

lines.zh: 我跑过的地方草又立起来
lines.en: The grass stands back up where I pass
Vines tangle in my tail

lines.zh: 我的蹄子把草压出一条道
lines.en: My hooves press a path through the grass

lines.zh: 我从一丛草走到另一丛
lines.en: I go from one clump of grass to the next

I trot slowly along the field ridge

lines.zh: 我的蹄声被草地吸走了
lines.en: The grass swallows my hoofbeats
New shoots push out as I walk
My shadow moves across the grass

lines.zh: 我站在草里，几乎看不出来
lines.en: I stand in the grass, almost invisible
My mane moves on its own
I stand in the sun and grow
New shoots are sprouting on my back
I chew the air once slowly
I wait for the grass to grow a little

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹得歪向一边
lines.en: The wind bends my mane to one side

lines.zh: 我的蹄边围着一圈小草
lines.en: A ring of small grass surrounds my hooves

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛上停了一只虫
lines.en: An insect has settled on my mane

lines.zh: 草的长度又增加了一点
lines.en: The grass has grown a little longer
I lower my head to the grass tips

lines.zh: 我站着，像一小片会呼吸的草
lines.en: I stand like a small patch of breathing grass
My back is good and warm

lines.zh: 我身上的芽一条条抬起来
lines.en: The shoots on me lift one by one
Your foot is on the grass

lines.zh: 我身上长的东西和我没关系
lines.en: What grows on me is not mine
Do you want grass, I have plenty here
You are standing at the edge of my grass

lines.zh: 我看起来像匹马，其实也是
lines.en: I look like a horse, and I am one
You carry no smell of grass
You walk heavily on the grass
My grass is not for you to tread
You do not look like one who plants

lines.zh: 我身上的绿都是从土里来的
lines.en: All my green comes from the soil

lines.zh: 你的靴底带着别处的土
lines.en: There is soil from elsewhere on your soles

lines.zh: 我在你脚印里看见草籽
lines.en: I see grass seed in your footprints
I lost grass and clay alike
A patch of my back is bare
My mane is pulled loose
I do not hurt, I am only a little cold

lines.zh: 我站在原处等它长回来
lines.en: I stand and wait for it to grow back
A big patch of my green has gone
The grass on my back was torn off
My clay is showing through
I do not hurt, I am only bare
I slowly wait for it to grow back
You are holding a handful of green
It is already growing inside me
I am not short of this at all

lines.zh: 你放地上吧，我自己会长
lines.en: Put it down, I will grow it myself
I know this smell well
You are holding a bunch of grass
I can grow grass myself

lines.zh: 你把它铺在土上会更好
lines.en: It would do better spread on the soil

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是看着它长
lines.en: I do not eat, I only watch it grow
This color is very fresh
I slowly lower my head toward it
The roots are still on that bunch
Do not raise it, I cannot see clearly
These blades still have mud on their roots
You hit my grass
A few of my blades snapped

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草屑飞起来
lines.en: We collided and grass bits flew up

lines.zh: 我退了半步，草又立回去
lines.en: I stepped back and the grass righted itself
My mane got mussed
That did not hurt at all
You knocked the grass off my back
My mane is pressed flat

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草叶乱飞
lines.en: We collided, blades flying

lines.zh: 我退了一步，绿又回来了
lines.en: I stepped back and the green returned
I am made of clay and grass
Such matters do not concern us
I only see to my grass
My kind each stand apart
I lower my head into the grass
That thought never came to me
We come from the grass
I only want to grow quietly
All my time goes to sprouting

lines.zh: 我把我身上的草理了理
lines.en: I tidy the grass on my back
This could be planted on my back
I tuck it into my mane
I want all the fallen grass
This is not fresh
I press it into the mud with a hoof
I gather the grass with a hoof
This can be planted on my back
I pick up a broken blade
Something has trodden over there
I raise my head to look
All the grass on me stands up

lines.zh: 我把四蹄摆正对着那边
lines.en: I square my four hooves that way
This thing carries no green
I take one slow step forward
That patch of grass has been pushed down
I raise my head and the green stands up
I dislike things that are not green
I watch it from low down
The grass hides half my body
I lower my mane and close on the grass.
I wait for it to walk into the grass
My hooves step very lightly
I watch the path it treads
Every step it takes crushes grass
I slowly stand in the middle of the meadow
My mane stands fully up
I sweep with a forehoof

lines.zh: 我撞过去，带着一片草屑
lines.en: I ram, trailing grass bits

lines.zh: 这一下只扬起一点草屑
lines.en: That only raised a bit of chaff
I step back and the grass rights itself
I butt it away with my head

lines.zh: 我的蹄子从草里抬起来
lines.en: My hoof lifts out of the grass

lines.zh: 这一下把草都带起来了
lines.en: That pulled up grass with it
I push once and back off

lines.zh: 我撞得它踩倒了一片草
lines.en: My charge made it crush a patch of grass
All the shoots on me burst outward
I rise out of a handful of grass
My mane turned green first
I was shaped from grass and clay
I step into the grass

lines.zh: 我的身体和草地一个颜色
lines.en: My body is the color of the meadow
I grow up out of grass roots
My hooves have just left the ground
Grass closes in around me first

lines.zh: 我醒来的时候是绿色的
lines.en: I was green when I woke

lines.zh: 我的身体和这片地一个颜色
lines.en: My body is the color of this land

lines.zh: 火把我的草烧成了黑丝
lines.en: Fire turned my grass to black threads

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，草散了一地
lines.en: I fell from height and grass scattered everywhere
Water flattened my grass

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的绿全掀掉了
lines.en: The blast stripped all my green away
An arrow passed through my mane

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的草疯长
lines.en: That magic made my grass grow wild
Grass is enough for me
Lightning scorched my grass
